lead_raw_text:
The structure of FePb₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pna2₁ (No. 33), with a unit cell containing eight atoms (Fe₂Pb₆) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers in octahedral coordination by six Pb neighbors, while Pb environments include a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement and an 8-neighbor coordination. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate edge-sharing between Fe octahedra and corner- and face-sharing between Fe octahedra and 12-vertex Pb polyhedra.
